name: Document store (this device + axHub data server, big files on the device)
description: Keeps an app's documents (projects, drafts, any JSON) with an index of them: always on this device, and when switched on also on axHub's data server (GET/PUT /data/<project>/<folder>/…, the browser's own hub session, If-Match, last save wins). A document bigger than the hub's 64 KB limit is split into a head and chunks automatically. Big binary files (videos, images) stay on the device in IndexedDB. Harvested Oct 22 2026 from Walkthrough Studio's project storage.

params.label: Folder name
params.help: Where documents live: a localStorage prefix on the device, a folder under the hub project.

parts.label: This device
parts.description: Documents and their index in localStorage (errors say when the device is full).

parts.label: axHub data server
parts.description: Also save to axHub's data server; the newer copy wins when loading. Needs the app's origin in AXHUB_DATA_ORIGINS.

parts.label: Files on the device
parts.description: Big binary files (screen videos, images) in IndexedDB, never sent anywhere.
